% Keep this --- needed by PGF outputs that reference \mathdefault
\providecommand{\mathdefault}[1]{#1}

% Figures are generated by plots/kalman_tfg/draw_plots.sh and moved here by
% CI. Guard every include so this document still compiles from a clean
% checkout: a chart gallery that cannot be built without first running the
% whole simulation is a gallery nobody rebuilds.
\newcommand{\ChartFigure}[2]{%
  \begin{figure}[H]\centering
    \IfFileExists{#1}{\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{\input{#1}}}%
      {\fbox{\parbox{0.9\textwidth}{\centering\small
        Figure \texttt{\detokenize{#1}} not generated.\\
        Run \texttt{plots/kalman\_tfg/draw\_plots.sh}.}}}
    \caption{#2}
  \end{figure}%
}

\title{Two-Frame Lie-Group Filter --- Wave Simulation Charts}
\author{Mikhail Grushinskiy}
\date{2026}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

Charts for the deterministic replays of the right-invariant two-frame
Lie-group filter (\texttt{src/kalman\_tfg}). Each record is a twenty-minute
replay; the tracking charts show the final \SI{60}{s}, while the adaptation
and bias charts show the whole run because they are about convergence rather
than steady-state tracking. RMS figures annotated on the tracking charts are
taken over the scored \SI{900}{s} window, so they agree with the results table
in the companion paper rather than describing only the minute on screen.

The wave-direction and frequency-tracker channels are not charted: this
filter's orchestrator does not carry those estimators, and plotting their
empty columns would present a missing feature as a measurement.

\ChartFigure{tfg_jonswap_H0.270_L14.047_A30.00_P60.00_heave.pgf}
